'''Bank of Life''' is an area of [[Tethys' Deep]], [[The Black Shores]], and a plant archive. Here, seeds collected by Bloom Bearers and Consultants from around the world are carefully nurtured by robot attendants. This vibrant underground section is where Solaris' flora gets systematically categorized.<ref>[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main/news/detail/1474 Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2]</ref>
